name: Spiral Mining Pool
description: High-performance solo and multi-coin cryptocurrency mining pool supporting Stratum V1/V2, Prometheus metrics, and web dashboard for Bitcoin, DigiByte, Litecoin, Dogecoin and more.
author: Spiral Pool Contributors

form_fields.label: Pool Mode
form_fields.hint: Choose 'single' to mine one dedicated cryptocurrency or 'multi' to mine multiple coins simultaneously.

form_fields.label: Primary Coin
form_fields.hint: Cryptocurrency mined when operating in single-coin mode.

form_fields.label: Pool ID
form_fields.hint: Unique pool identifier used for metrics and dashboard reporting.

form_fields.label: Primary Wallet Address
form_fields.hint: Primary coin wallet address for receiving block rewards (for example, bc1q... or dgb1q...).

form_fields.label: Coinbase Text
form_fields.hint: Custom text written into the coinbase transaction of mined blocks.

form_fields.label: Primary Stratum V1 Port
form_fields.hint: Stratum V1 listening port (for example: BTC 4333, DGB 3333, LTC 7333, DOGE 8335).

form_fields.label: Enable Stratum V2
form_fields.hint: Enables the Stratum V2 protocol with Noise end-to-end encryption.

form_fields.label: Daemon Host
form_fields.hint: Hostname or IP address of the blockchain node (for example, bitcoind or a local network IP).

form_fields.label: Daemon RPC Port
form_fields.hint: Blockchain node RPC port (for example: BTC 8332, DGB 14022, LTC 9332).

form_fields.label: Daemon ZMQ Port
form_fields.hint: Blockchain node ZMQ block notification port (for example: BTC 28332, DGB 28532, LTC 28933).

form_fields.label: Daemon RPC Username
form_fields.hint: RPC username configured on the blockchain node (optional if using cookie authentication).

form_fields.label: Daemon RPC Password
form_fields.hint: RPC password configured on the blockchain node (optional if using cookie authentication).

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: Enable Bitcoin
form_fields.hint: Enables Bitcoin (BTC) mining when operating in multi-coin mode.

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: Bitcoin Address
form_fields.hint: Bitcoin wallet address used when ENABLE_BTC is enabled.

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: Enable DigiByte
form_fields.hint: Enables DigiByte (DGB) mining when operating in multi-coin mode.

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: DigiByte Address
form_fields.hint: DigiByte wallet address used when ENABLE_DGB is enabled.

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: Enable Litecoin
form_fields.hint: Enables Litecoin (Scrypt) mining when operating in multi-coin mode.

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: Litecoin Address
form_fields.hint: Litecoin wallet address used when ENABLE_LTC is enabled.

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: Enable Dogecoin
form_fields.hint: Enables Dogecoin (Scrypt) mining when operating in multi-coin mode.

form_fields.label: Multi Mode: Dogecoin Address
form_fields.hint: Dogecoin wallet address used when ENABLE_DOGE is enabled.

form_fields.label: Enable Merge Mining
form_fields.hint: Enables simultaneous auxiliary coin merge mining (for example: LTC+DOGE or BTC+NMC).

form_fields.label: Dashboard Admin Password
form_fields.hint: Password for accessing the pool web control dashboard.

form_fields.label: PostgreSQL Database Password
form_fields.hint: Internal PostgreSQL password used by the pool database.
